en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a man who insulted a man without slander, would he be treated harshly? Is there a Penalty (Hadd) upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘Upon him is the reprimanding’.
